findings: When the mystic worldboss was active, one full Startseite paint called bossFree three times inside the boss card plus once for Tagesziele.
bossFree invokes v110ResetDay, so a purely visual render repeated the daily-reset helper up to four times.
The event-only boss panel path also repeated the same helper.

An event-only boss activation also calculates that state once and reuses it for the patched boss card and goal.
